summary: Salazar's congressional record aligns squarely with shielding Israel during the Gaza war. She sponsored H.Res. 1117 in April 2024 opposing one-sided pressure on Israel and criticizing the administration's ceasefire push. In 2021 she co-signed a letter to the FBI and FinCen demanding investigation of PACBI, framing BDS as terrorism. In May 2024 she voted Yea on H.R. 6090, embedding the IHRA definition in Title VI education enforcement.
